page.title: Why impact certs might be really good

text.content: I’ve been pushing hard for impact certs (aka equity for charities; aka retroactive public goods funding). But people outside the startup space often don’t see the benefits

rich_text.plain_text: I’ve been pushing hard for impact certs (aka equity for charities; aka retroactive public goods funding). But people outside the startup space often don’t see the benefits

text.content: A reminder: impact certificates are like a VC funding ecosystem for charity. Charity founders with good ideas sell shares in their proposed projects. Profit-seeking investors buy shares of (“invest in”) projects that they expect to succeed. This funds the project; if it does succeed, altruistic people/foundations (“final oracular funders”) buy the impact, compensating the investors.
